descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Kay the engineer at the Omega Sector.
descriptions.inProgress: I met Kay the Engineer again at the Silo of the Omega Sector. She first wanted to make sure that I didn't forget that I volunteered to be her assistant. Then, she said she needed a number of memory cards that contain Rombot Control Program, and asked me to collect 3 #bRombot's Memory Cards#k, which can be found through Rombot the monster at the Eos Tower. Then, I'll have to pay a visit to #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and have him decipher the memory cards, and then hand her the #b3 Deciphered Memory Cards#k to her.
descriptions.completed: I defeated the Rombots that have been hidden in Eos Tower and got a hold of the #bRombot's Memory Cards#k. I then handed them to Porter to decipher the code.
